purpose: medical bay aboard Valkyrie-1; functional human retrofit within the ship's organic architecture

reference_images.label: Approved Med Module
reference_images.instruction: match this room: one low treatment couch at the center, a few compact instruments in curved wall recesses, soft pearl light

reference_images.label: Valkyrie-1 interior architecture (from the approved ALARA lab still)
reference_images.instruction: same ship, different room: match the architecture and realism only (pale pearl ribbed arches, leaf-shaped petal door, translucent crystalline wall panels with faint violet inside, dark polished floor, low warm light). The golden veins and spiral are ALARA, not the room: leave them out. Do not copy the lab's shelves, crystals, bottles or tables

reference_images.label: Approved Observation Deck
reference_images.instruction: same ship: match the materials only (pearl-silver shell edges with fine violet veins inside, dark reflective floor, thin warm line of light). No window, no planets, no person
